name: codex-automation-recommender
description: An independent, read-only OpenAI Codex plugin that reviews a repository and recommends evidence-based improvements to instructions, skills, agents, hooks, MCP servers, plugins, and built-in features.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-based Codex setup advice for a repository
interface.longDescription: Reviews a repository read-only and recommends relevant Codex instructions, skills, agents, hooks, MCP servers, plugins, or built-in features, with evidence, trade-offs, and requirements.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $codex-automation-recommender to review this repository. Recommend evidence-based Codex setup improvements, explain trade-offs and requirements, and keep the review read-only.
